title: A New Pool, a New You
displayName: Week 15 Tuesday A New Pool, a New You

source.pdf: 初2第3辑初中时文阅读提分训练3+X第3辑8年级.pdf

images.alt: A pair of black flip-flops on the white tiled edge of a swimming pool, with rippling water beside them

content.v: Have you ever stood at the
edge
of something new and exciting, such as an opportunity or a dream? How did you feel at the time? Were you too afraid to dive in because you thought it would be too
challenging
One of my students recently told me about a composition she wrote. She was asked to
comment on

this saying: Don’t be afraid of getting your feet wet if you want to learn how to swim. These words reminded me of all the leaps of faith I’ve taken. By repeatedly stepping out of my comfort zone, I’ve learnt and grown a lot.
I remember a friend telling me that I could build a home in a shoebox. She didn’t mean it
literally

, of course. Rather, she was referring to my frequent moves. I’ve never been afraid to leave everything I knew behind and make a home wherever my career and curiosity led me. I have lived and worked in twelve countries and visited many more. I’ve spread my wings in various cultures and gone through many different experiences—both good and bad. Honestly, each time I set off on a new adventure, I didn’t know what to expect. But now, I clearly know that if I hadn’t taken those leaps of faith, I wouldn’t be who I am today.

The end of one learning stage signals the start of another. It’s impossible to know what will come your way. At some point, you may face a big challenge. You might make mistakes and experience failure. It’s natural to be afraid of failure, especially if you care deeply about the result. But you shouldn’t let that fear stop you. Failure makes you learn and forces you to be creative. If you avoid trying at all, you won’t move forward and grow.

Life is made up of many new and exciting “pools”. Whenever you stand by a new one, tell yourself to be brave. Don’t be afraid to get your feet—or even your whole body—wet. That’s the only way to learn how to swim and become a better version of yourself!
